creative_direction.name: Powder Rose Bow Halo
creative_direction.brief: 把蝴蝶结放大成一轮粉雾日晕：摄影感玫瑰泥墙上悬一枚巨大硬边浅玫瑰圆环，圆心精确对齐蝴蝶结，圆环从其身后掠过却不触碰标签，像把织带的弧度扩成建筑拱线；连续磨光浅玫瑰地面在真实基准线处接墙，商品低立于地，接触阴影轻落粉面。左上一组宽距 Arial Narrow 排印在圆环之外的安静墙区结束于瓶顶之上，构成对角纪念碑网格；一条玫瑰细线短促垫于文字组下如拱心石刻度。粉泥的矿物哑光与银盖镜面、桃色液体的柔光互为冷暖与柔刚。
creative_direction.material: powder rose mineral plaster wall with honed matching rose ground and one hard-edge pale rose disc
creative_direction.lighting: soft high-key diffuse daylight, gentle frontal with one broad calm glow on the disc, no hard shadows

background.prompt: Powder rose mineral plaster wall in medium saturated dusty rose meeting a continuous honed pale rose ground at a horizontal horizon seven tenths down the frame, one large hard-edge flat disc in lighter blush rose centred at one third down the frame, matte mineral grain, soft high-key diffuse illumination, no objects

spec.lighting: soft high-key diffuse daylight, gentle frontal with one broad calm glow on the disc, no hard shadows
